intromsq1_001.desc: MISSION DESIGN [1/5] — Launch Vehicle: Our mass budget is tight! Do we book NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) for crew comfort, or a heavy cargo rocket for extra armor?

right.desc: Launch on SLS Block 1B with full crew quarters.

left.desc: Cram the crew into a heavy cargo lander.

intromsq1_002.desc: MISSION DESIGN [2/5] — Lunar Orbit: We can dock at the Lunar Gateway station in a wide halo orbit for resupplies, or dive straight into Low Lunar Orbit to save fuel.

right.desc: Dock at Gateway for extra food and comms.

left.desc: Burn straight for Low Lunar Orbit to save power.

intromsq1_003.desc: MISSION DESIGN [3/5] — Landing Site: Touch down on Shackleton Crater's sunny South Pole rim for constant solar power, or inside a basalt lava tube for natural shielding?

right.desc: Land on Shackleton's sunny South Pole ridge.

left.desc: Land inside the armored Mare Lava Tube pit.

intromsq1_004.desc: MISSION DESIGN [4/5] — Base Systems: Our lander only has room for one heavy module! Pack a Kilopower nuclear reactor, or an expanded Veggie hydroponic farm?

right.desc: Pack the Kilopower nuclear fission core.

left.desc: Pack the expanded Veggie hydroponic greenhouse.

intromsq1_005.desc: MISSION DESIGN [5/5] — Science Payload: Touchdown confirmed! For our final payload bay, do we activate the NASA Rover homing beacon, or the deep-space SETI dish?

right.desc: Ping NASA's lost VIPER rover nearby!

left.desc: Fire up the deep-space SETI radio dish!

upgrademsq2_001_start.desc: COLONY UPGRADE [START] — Lunar Gateway just dropped a heavy orbital upgrade module! Do we build the Anti-Meteor Defense Grid, or the Bio-Dome & Oxygen Control Core?

right.desc: Construct the Anti-Meteor Laser Turret & Shield Grid.

left.desc: Build the Pressurized Bio-Dome & Oxygen Control Core.

upgrademsq2_002_security.desc: SECURITY UPGRADE [1/3] — Point-Defense Turrets: We're mounting automated Whipple shields and laser turrets on the roof to vaporize incoming micrometeorites!

right.desc: Link the turrets to orbital tracking radar for max accuracy.

left.desc: Install solar-capacitor banks on the turret barrels.

upgrademsq2_002_lifesupport.desc: LIFE SUPPORT [1/3] — Cryo-Oxygen Tanks: We're replacing our old air valves with triple-redundant Kevlar oxygen tanks and automated pressure regulators!

right.desc: Enrich the cabin air mix for peak crew health and focus.

left.desc: Route spare liquid oxygen to boost the fuel cells.

upgrademsq2_003_security.desc: SECURITY UPGRADE [2/3] — Magnetosphere Projector: The anti-meteor turrets are online! Now we're wiring a superconducting magnetic dome to deflect cosmic radiation.

right.desc: Tune the magnetic field to double as a radiation bunker.

left.desc: Harvest solar-wind ions from the shield for free power.

upgrademsq2_003_lifesupport.desc: LIFE SUPPORT [2/3] — Eden Bio-Dome: With the oxygen tanks secured, we're inflating a sunlit hydroponic Bio-Dome filled with air-scrubbing orchard trees!

right.desc: Plant high-calorie dwarf fruit trees and berry vines.

left.desc: Add therapeutic park benches and UV sunlamps for the crew.

upgrademsq2_004_security.desc: SECURITY UPGRADE [3/3] — Aegis Defense Network Complete! A meteor storm approaches, and our automated laser turrets blast the space rocks into harmless metallic dust!

right.desc: Scoop up the vaporized meteor iron to reinforce the hull!

left.desc: Throw a crew viewing party under the invincible dome!

upgrademsq2_004_lifesupport.desc: LIFE SUPPORT [3/3] — Oasis Core Complete! The Bio-Dome and smart oxygen tanks are running in a 100% closed loop—fresh breeze and ripe harvests fill the base!

right.desc: Feast on fresh Bio-Dome produce and pure mountain air!

left.desc: Store excess liquid oxygen and biofuel for emergencies!

upgrademsq2_visit_security.desc: Pew-pew! The Aegis anti-meteor turrets just sniped another stray asteroid chunk out of the sky, and the magnetic shield is humming smoothly!

right.desc: Smelt the asteroid fragments into fresh hull plating!

left.desc: Siphon excess capacitor energy straight into the base grid!

upgrademsq2_visit_lifesupport.desc: Breathe easy! The Bio-Dome orchards just hit peak harvest, and the smart oxygen tanks report 100% pure air pressure across all habitats!

right.desc: Serve fresh orchard fruit and boost cabin oxygen!

left.desc: Vent spare oxygen into the fuel cells for clean energy!

roversidequest_001_start.desc: ROVER QUEST [START] — NASA's lost VIPER rover rolls up to our airlock, flashing its headlights! Its link to Earth is dead, and its ice-scanner is pinging nearby.

right.desc: Drain our grid to send it ice mining.

left.desc: Send it to the sunny ridge as a scout.

roversidequest_002_ice.desc: ROVER QUEST [1/3] — VIPER's wheels are sinking into fluffy 'fairy-castle' moon dust inside a dark crater! Spinning the tires will bury its belly pan.

right.desc: Use NASA's 'Inchworm' wheel-lifting crawl.

left.desc: Floor the throttle and yank it out with winches!

roversidequest_002_scout.desc: ROVER QUEST [1/3] — The rover clipped a rock and ripped off its back fender! Static-charged moon dust is coating its heat mirrors and cooking its circuits.

right.desc: Tape laminated colony maps over the wheel.

left.desc: Drive it into a freezing crater to cool down.

roversidequest_003_ice.desc: ROVER QUEST [2/3] — At -235°C in the dark crater, VIPER's drill hits rock-hard ice! The drill is straining, and the battery heaters only have 4 hours left.

right.desc: Peck slowly using NASA's 'bite-and-brush' drill rule.

left.desc: Max the drill torque and ignore the battery alarm!

roversidequest_003_scout.desc: ROVER QUEST [2/3] — Siren alert! NASA satellites spotted a huge Solar Flare heading our way. Radiation on the exposed ridge will fry the rover's computer!

right.desc: Park behind a boulder in NASA 'Safe Mode.'

left.desc: Keep driving through the radiation storm!

roversidequest_004_ice.desc: ROVER QUEST [3/3] — Jackpot! VIPER dug up 5% pure water-ice and ammonia! It drops off the load at base before heading out on permanent deep-crater patrol.

right.desc: Melt the ice and ammonia for our farms!

left.desc: Split the water into oxygen and rocket fuel!

roversidequest_004_scout.desc: ROVER QUEST [3/3] — VIPER found a 'Peak of Eternal Light' with 92% year-round sunshine and titanium ore! It sets up a ridge outpost to run solo patrols.

right.desc: Link its new solar tower to our power grid!

left.desc: Bake the titanium dirt into dome armor bricks!

roversidequest_visit_ice.desc: Beep-beep! VIPER is back from its crater patrol, covered in frost and flashing its headlights at the airlock with a fresh load of ice!

right.desc: Refill the greenhouses and clean its camera!

left.desc: Crack the ice for fuel and patch its drill!

roversidequest_visit_scout.desc: Look who's back! VIPER rolls down from the sunny ridge, beaming spare solar power and towing a sled of titanium rocks!

right.desc: Drain its batteries and tune up its wheels!

left.desc: Armor the hull with titanium and send it back!

aliensidequest_001_dip.desc: ALIEN CONTACT [1/2] — An alien delegation approaches the perimeter, broadcasting a peaceful mathematical sequence.

right.desc: Welcome them with open arms.

left.desc: Lock down the base and aim weapons.

aliensidequest_001_com.desc: ALIEN CONTACT [1/2] — Alien vessels lock weapons onto our primary dome! Our refusal to share resources has provoked an attack.

right.desc: Return fire with everything we have!

left.desc: Beg for mercy and pay tribute.

aliensidequest_002_dip.desc: ALIEN CONTACT [2/2] — The alien envoys share crystalline zero-point energy matrices and bio-seeds in exchange for our peaceful hospitality!

right.desc: Plug their zero-point matrix into our main grid!

left.desc: Plant the alien star-seeds in our hydroponic bays!

aliensidequest_002_com.desc: ALIEN CONTACT [2/2] — The alien scout ship crashes into a nearby crater after our laser barrage! Its exotic alloy hull is still smoking.

right.desc: Salvage the alien armor plating for our domes!

left.desc: Siphon the ship's antimatter fuel cells!

right.desc: Divert power to the greenhouses.

left.desc: Starve the crew on half-rations.

right.desc: Shut down life support and shields.

left.desc: Let the grid brown out.

main_003.desc: A shallow magnitude 4.5 moonquake is shaking the ground! The habitat domes are groaning as the fault line shifts underneath us.

right.desc: Max out the magnetic shock absorbers.

left.desc: Do nothing and hope the domes hold.

main_004.desc: Our NASA 'Veggie' garden pods are drowning! In low gravity, water forms bubbles around the lettuce roots and suffocates them.

right.desc: Blast the roots with high-power air fans.

left.desc: Feed the rotting greens to the crew.

main_005.desc: Glass-sharp moon dust is sticking to our spacesuits! It's chewing up the airlock seals and giving the crew 'Apollo hay fever.'

right.desc: Zap the suits with electric dust shields.

left.desc: Track the toxic dust inside anyway.

main_006.desc: Our Kilopower nuclear reactor is running hot! We can push the uranium core harder for energy, or cool it down to protect the base.

right.desc: Yank the control rod and disable alarms!

left.desc: Scram the reactor and bury it in dirt.

main_007.desc: A lunar satellite spotted a collapsed lava tube cave two kilometers away! Its thick stone roof offers natural radiation shielding.

right.desc: Winch a rover down to mine volcanic rock.

left.desc: Send astronauts on foot without ropes.

main_008.desc: The life-support water recycler is clogged! Low gravity makes the crew lose bone calcium, and that mineral sludge is jamming our urine filters.

right.desc: Boil the filters clean with spare power.

left.desc: Drink the unfiltered urine to save power.

main_009.desc: Wait—is that Surveyor 3?! A scout found a 1960s NASA probe sitting in a crater, still wrapped in shiny foil and titanium struts.

right.desc: Strip its camera and titanium like Apollo 12.

left.desc: Melt the historic probe down for scrap.

main_010.desc: The Geminid meteor shower is pelting the Moon! With no atmosphere to burn them up, tiny space pebbles are hitting faster than bullets.

right.desc: Drop blast shutters and power the shields.

left.desc: Leave the glass domes and solar panels exposed.

main_011.desc: One of our cube-shaped NASA Astrobee robots went haywire in the cafeteria! Its fans are blowing floating crumbs everywhere while it sings 'Daisy Bell.'

right.desc: Wipe its memory and force it on leak patrol.

left.desc: Smash it with a wrench.

main_012.desc: NASA's Lunar Gateway space station is passing right overhead! They can drop us a supply pod if we guide it down to the landing pad.

right.desc: Burn laser power to guide it down safely.

left.desc: Turn off the beacon and let it crash near base.

main_013.desc: Living in one-sixth gravity is weakening the crew's bones and making their vision blurry! Doctors warn that health is slipping fast.

right.desc: Force 2-hour daily vacuum workouts.

left.desc: Ignore the doctors and work them harder.

main_014.desc: Our moon-dirt smelter is glowing at 1,600°C! Baking lunar soil separates out pure oxygen gas and leaves behind molten iron.

right.desc: Bottle the oxygen for the crew.

left.desc: Dump uncooled molten iron straight onto the hull.

main_015.desc: NASA's deep-space laser dish just locked onto our receiver! We have ultra-fast internet from Earth for the next 20 minutes.

right.desc: Download solar-storm shield patches.

left.desc: Pirate unverified code to overclock the grid.

main_016.desc: Weird pink space-slime is growing inside our cooling pipes! Tough bacteria survived radiation and are blocking water flow to the computers.

right.desc: Boil the pipes and compost the dead slime.

left.desc: Flush the cooling water into space.

main_017.desc: Our Valkyrie humanoid robot froze up while fixing the outer antenna! It's stuck hanging onto the tower as deadly shadow creeps in.

right.desc: Send a rover team into the cold to rescue it.

left.desc: Leave it to freeze and shatter on the tower.

main_018.desc: Our miners scooped up moon dirt packed with Helium-3 from solar wind! The engineers want to test it in our unshielded fusion prototype.

right.desc: Dump raw Helium-3 into the unshielded core!

left.desc: Play it safe: sift the dirt for crop nitrogen.

main_019.desc: We found an old Apollo laser mirror out on the plains! Scientists on Earth still bounce green laser beams off it to measure the Moon's orbit.

right.desc: Use canned air to blow dust off the mirror.

left.desc: Pry the mirror up and blind Earth's lasers.

main_020.desc: The crew in Habitat B has 'space cabin fever,' and the sewage tank is full! NASA research shows human waste is great at blocking cosmic rays.

right.desc: Line the bedroom walls with bagged sewage.

left.desc: Vent the raw sewage right outside the airlock.

main_021.desc: We dug up a pocket of 'Orange Soil'—tiny volcanic glass beads from 3.6 billion years ago, just like Apollo 17 found!

right.desc: Bake the beads at 900°C to extract water.

left.desc: Melt the glass into 3D-printed dome armor.

main_022.desc: The two-week lunar night is at its coldest! It's -248°C outside, and the habitat's outer cooling pipes are about to freeze solid and burst.

right.desc: Kill the greenhouse heat to thaw the pipes.

left.desc: Let the outer pipes freeze and burst!
